title.id: Lenore Exquisite Dining Expands with a Second Destination at Plaza Indonesia
title.en: Lenore Exquisite Dining Expands with a Second Destination at Plaza Indonesia

summary.id: Lenore Exquisite Dining dengan bangga menandai tonggak baru dengan pembukaan lokasi keduanya di Plaza Indonesia, salah satu destinasi lifestyle paling prestisius di Jakarta.
summary.en: Lenore Exquisite Dining proudly marks a new milestone with the opening of its second location at Plaza Indonesia, one of Jakarta's most prestigious lifestyle destinations.

body.id:
Lenore Exquisite Dining dengan bangga menandai tonggak baru dengan pembukaan lokasi keduanya di Plaza Indonesia, salah satu destinasi lifestyle paling prestisius di Jakarta. Menyusul kesuksesan restoran flagship di Barito, ekspansi ini mencerminkan komitmen Lenore untuk membawa pengalaman kuliner khasnya ke audiens yang lebih luas.

Berlokasi di Level 3 Plaza Indonesia, destinasi baru ini memperkenalkan Lenore Kitchen—ekspresi kontemporer dari filosofi Lenore, di mana masakan istimewa, craftsmanship yang halus, dan hospitality yang hangat bersatu dalam suasana yang hidup. Dirancang untuk business lunch maupun pertemuan sosial yang santai, ruang baru ini menawarkan pengalaman dining yang elevated di jantung kota.
body.en:
Lenore Exquisite Dining proudly marks a new milestone with the opening of its second location at Plaza Indonesia, one of Jakarta's most prestigious lifestyle destinations. Following the success of its flagship restaurant in Barito, this expansion reflects Lenore's commitment to bringing its signature culinary experience to a wider audience.

Located on Level 3 of Plaza Indonesia, the new destination introduces Lenore Kitchen—a contemporary expression of the Lenore philosophy, where exceptional cuisine, refined craftsmanship, and warm hospitality come together in a vibrant setting. Designed for both business lunches and relaxed social gatherings, the new space offers an elevated dining experience in the heart of the city.

title.id: Sound Session every Friday at Terrata Social Dining
title.en: Sound Session every Friday at Terrata Social Dining

summary.id: Setiap Jumat pukul 19.00, Terrata Social Dining hidup dengan Sound Session, pengalaman musik live mingguan yang menyatukan musik hebat, makanan istimewa, dan koneksi yang bermakna.
summary.en: Every Friday at 7 PM, Terrata Social Dining comes alive with Sound Session, a weekly live music experience that brings together great music, exceptional food, and meaningful connections.

body.id: Setiap Jumat pukul 19.00, Terrata Social Dining hidup dengan Sound Session, pengalaman musik live mingguan yang menyatukan musik hebat, makanan istimewa, dan koneksi yang bermakna. Menampilkan musisi lokal berbakat, setiap penampilan menciptakan suasana hangat dan hidup bagi tamu untuk bersantai setelah sepekan yang padat. Baik Anda menikmati makan malam bersama keluarga, bertemu teman, atau sekadar bersantai sambil minum, Sound Session adalah cara sempurna menghabiskan malam Jumat di Terrata.
body.en: Every Friday at 7 PM, Terrata Social Dining comes alive with Sound Session, a weekly live music experience that brings together great music, exceptional food, and meaningful connections. Featuring talented local musicians, each performance creates a warm and vibrant atmosphere for guests to unwind after a long week. Whether you're enjoying dinner with family, catching up with friends, or simply relaxing over drinks, Sound Session is the perfect way to spend your Friday evening at Terrata.

short.id: Furnitur kelas atas dengan desain berkelas dan kualitas produk kelas satu.
short.en: High-end furniture with tasteful design and first-class product quality.

body.id: Elementi Domus adalah pilihan utama untuk furnitur kelas atas dengan desain yang berkelas dan indah, serta kualitas produk kelas satu. Elementi Domus menghadirkan desain yang abadi sekaligus berwawasan ke depan. Setiap kreasi mencerminkan komitmen terhadap keunikan, kualitas, dan inovasi, menetapkan standar baru dalam sistem furnitur dan solusi hunian.
body.en: The preferred choice for high-end furniture by providing tasteful and exquisite designs, first-class product quality. Elementi Domus delivers designs that are both timeless and forward-thinking. Every creation reflects a commitment to uniqueness, quality, and innovation, setting new standards in furniture systems and living solutions.

short.id: Pabrik kayu terkemuka untuk panel kayu berorientasi ekspor.
short.en: Premier wood factory specializing in export-oriented wood panels.

body.id: Pabrik kayu terkemuka di Indonesia yang berspesialisasi dalam panel kayu berorientasi ekspor. Di Legnotura, kami bangga dengan komitmen kami terhadap inovasi dan keberlanjutan, menciptakan panel kayu dari bahan daur ulang dan bahan-bahan mutakhir.
body.en: Premier Indonesian wood factory specializing in export-oriented wood panels. At Legnotura, we take pride in our commitment to innovation and sustainability, crafting wood panels from recycled and cutting-edge materials.

short.id: Filosofi bersantap mewah yang menerangi indera.
short.en: A fine-dining philosophy that illuminates the senses.

body.id: Terinspirasi oleh nama "Lenore" yang berarti cahaya atau yang terang, filosofi kami berpusat pada penerangan indera dan perayaan seni bersantap mewah.
body.en: Inspired by the name "Lenore" which means light or the bright one, our philosophy revolves around illuminating the senses and celebrating the art of fine dining.

short.id: Ruang sosial di luar sekadar bersantap — koneksi dan kebersamaan.
short.en: A social space beyond dining — connection and togetherness.

body.id: Dirancang sebagai ruang sosial di luar sekadar bersantap, Terrata menyatukan orang-orang melalui makanan lezat, lingkungan yang nyaman, dan pengalaman yang bermakna. Baik untuk bekerja, berkumpul, atau bersantai, setiap sudutnya diciptakan untuk menginspirasi koneksi dan kebersamaan.
body.en: Designed as a social space beyond dining, Terrata brings people together through great food, comfortable surroundings, and meaningful experiences. Whether for work, gatherings, or leisure, every corner is created to inspire connection and togetherness.

short.id: Hospitality premium dengan kenyamanan dan layanan personal.
short.en: Premium hospitality with comfort and personalized service.

body.id: Rasakan arti sebenarnya dari kenyamanan hidup bersama kami. Bersantai, rileks, dan nikmati gaya hidup yang dirancang sesuai kebutuhan Anda, di mana kenyamanan dan kemudahan menyatu dengan sempurna.

id.hero.lede:
PT Diana Karya Gemilang adalah perusahaan Indonesia yang berdedikasi meningkatkan pengalaman lifestyle melalui desain, craftsmanship, dan hospitality yang luar biasa.

Portofolio kami meliputi Elementi Domus dan Legnotura, yang mengkhususkan diri dalam pembuatan interior kelas atas; Lenore Exquisite Dining dan Terrata Social Dining, yang menawarkan masakan fusion Barat, Italia, Asia, dan Indonesia yang dikurasi dengan cermat; dan De Diana's Home, merek perhotelan kami yang berdedikasi untuk menyediakan akomodasi mewah dengan kenyamanan, layanan personal, dan pengalaman tamu yang tak terlupakan.

Bersama-sama, merek-merek kami mencerminkan semangat yang sama untuk keahlian, inovasi, dan kualitas abadi.

id.about.p1: PT Diana Karya Gemilang adalah grup perusahaan yang mengawasi beragam portofolio bisnis di bidang Manufaktur, Makanan & Minuman, dan Perhotelan. Didirikan dengan komitmen untuk memberikan produk dan layanan premium, kami berupaya menciptakan nilai berkelanjutan bagi pelanggan, mitra bisnis, dan komunitas yang kami layani.
id.about.p2: Dipandu oleh prinsip-prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik, didukung oleh talenta profesional, dan didorong oleh budaya integritas, kami berkomitmen pada pertumbuhan berkelanjutan dan inovasi terus-menerus sambil memperkuat daya saing kami di pasar nasional dan internasional.

id.mission.1: Mengembangkan portofolio bisnis premium yang didorong oleh kualitas, inovasi, dan kepuasan pelanggan.
id.mission.2: Membangun budaya perusahaan yang menjunjung tinggi integritas, profesionalisme, dan kolaborasi.
id.mission.3: Menerapkan prinsip-prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (GCG) di seluruh aktivitas bisnis.
id.mission.4: Menciptakan pertumbuhan berkelanjutan melalui inovasi, keunggulan operasional, dan pengembangan sumber daya manusia yang berkelanjutan.
id.mission.5: Memberikan kontribusi positif kepada masyarakat, lingkungan, dan semua pemangku kepentingan.

en.hero.lede:
PT Diana Karya Gemilang is an Indonesian company dedicated to elevating lifestyle experiences through exceptional design, craftsmanship, and hospitality.

Our portfolio includes Elementi Domus and Legnotura, specializing in high-end interior manufacturing; Lenore Exquisite Dining and Terrata Social Dining, offering thoughtfully curated Western, Italian, Asian, and Indonesian fusion cuisine; and De Diana's Home, our hospitality brand dedicated to providing refined accommodations with comfort, personalized service, and memorable guest experiences.

Together, our brands reflect a shared passion for craftsmanship, innovation, and timeless quality.
en.about.title: One Vision, United Through the Synergy of Our Subsidiaries
en.about.p1: PT Diana Karya Gemilang is a holding company overseeing a diverse portfolio of businesses across Manufacturing, Food & Beverage, and Hospitality. Established with a commitment to delivering premium products and services, we strive to create lasting value for our customers, business partners, and the communities we serve.
en.about.p2: Guided by the principles of Good Corporate Governance, supported by professional talent, and driven by a culture of integrity, we are committed to sustainable growth and continuous innovation while strengthening our competitiveness in both national and international markets.
en.vision.title: To be a leading lifestyle holding company that inspires better living through excellence, innovation, and timeless quality.
en.mission.1: Developing a premium business portfolio driven by quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
en.mission.2: Building a corporate culture that upholds integrity, professionalism, and collaboration.
en.mission.3: Implementing Good Corporate Governance (GCG) principles across all business activities.
en.mission.4: Creating sustainable growth through innovation, operational excellence, and continuous human resource development.
en.mission.5: Delivering positive contributions to society, the environment, and all stakeholders.
en.values.title: Five pillars that guide every decision we make.
en.values.integrity: Conducting business with honesty, transparency, and professional ethics.
en.values.excellence: Committed to delivering the highest quality in every product, service, and process.
en.values.innovation: Continuously adapting and driving new ideas that create added value.
en.values.collaboration: Believing success is built through partnership and synergy.
en.values.sustainability: Balancing economic growth with social and environmental responsibility.
en.business.title: Three Business Lines, One Standard of Premium Quality
en.business.h.desc: Developing and managing hospitality businesses dedicated to providing refined accommodations, personalized service, and exceptional guest experiences with the highest standards of comfort and quality.
en.business.h.more: Our services include premium accommodation management and guest-experience strategies with high service standards.
en.business.f.desc: Developing and operating premium restaurants, cafés, and culinary concepts that deliver exceptional cuisine, refined hospitality, and memorable dining experiences.
en.business.f.more: We deliver sustainable menu innovation, culinary supply-chain management, and exclusive dining experiences across every business line.
en.business.m.desc: Designing and manufacturing premium furniture and interior solutions with a strong commitment to exceptional craftsmanship, precision engineering, innovative design, and outstanding customer service.
en.business.m.more: Our manufacturing facilities are supported by modern technology and experienced craftsmen to create works of high aesthetic quality.
en.business.l.title: Lifestyle Business
en.business.l.desc: Developing businesses that support modern lifestyles, prioritizing quality, aesthetics, and customer satisfaction.
en.business.l.more: Reaching retail, wellness, and entertainment sectors designed to complete today’s exclusive lifestyle needs.
